en.headline: Yuen Long district councillor sentenced to 2.5 years for unlawful sex with minor
en.dek: The District Court imposed the term on Tuesday after Sei Chun-hing was convicted of intercourse with a girl under 16 in 2011.
body: The District Court on Tuesday sentenced Yuen Long District Council member Sei Chun-hing to two and a half years’ imprisonment after he was convicted of unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 16.
The conviction related to an incident in 2011. Sei was earlier acquitted of a separate indecent-assault charge involving the same complainant.

Under the District Councils Ordinance, a member convicted of an offence and sentenced to more than three months’ imprisonment without the option of a fine is disqualified from holding office. The government said both sides retain the right to appeal and it will monitor the proceedings.

A government statement noted that Sei’s remuneration as a district councillor has been suspended since his conviction in September. The Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs has appointed a supervisory committee to follow up.

zh.headline: 元朗區議員施駿興非法性交罪成判囚兩年半
zh.dek: 區域法院周二判刑，施駿興早前被裁定2011年與未滿16歲女童性交罪成。
body: 區域法院周二裁定，元朗區議員施駿興因與未滿16歲女童非法性交罪成，判處監禁兩年半。
控罪涉及2011年的事件。施早前就同一事主的另一項非禮控罪被裁定罪名不成立。
根據《區議會條例》，區議員若被定罪並判處超過三個月監禁且無罰款選擇，即喪失職位。政府表示控辯雙方均有權上訴，將密切留意司法程序發展。
政府聲明指出，施的區議員酬津自九月定罪後已暫停。民政及青年事務局局長已委任監督委員會跟進。
